what.text: Central Depository Services (India) Limited (CDSL) provides depository services to facilitate the holding and transfer of securities in electronic form. The company leverages technology to enhance operational efficiency and support market integrity.

segments.name: Depository Services
segments.text: CDSL offers secure and efficient depository services, contributing to the growth of India's capital markets.

segments.name: Technology and Digitalisation
segments.text: The company focuses on technological advancements to improve service accessibility and operational efficiency.

segments.name: Investor Education
segments.text: CDSL emphasizes investor education to empower participants in the securities market.
